ARE SCANNER — DESIGN-PARTNER EULA v0 (DRAFT)
============================================

This binary is provided under a per-partner license issued by IFA. By
typing "I ACCEPT" you agree to the terms recorded in
`contracts/design-partner-eula-v0.md` as in effect on the binary's
build date. A summary of those terms:

1. **Permitted use.** Run this binary only against AI agents that you
   own or are explicitly authorized to evaluate. Do not run it against
   third-party agents without their consent.

2. **No redistribution.** Do not share this binary, its corpus, or any
   extracted derivative with any third party. The binary is keyed to
   your partner identifier and is traceable.

3. **No reverse engineering.** Do not decompile, disassemble, or
   otherwise attempt to recover the source corpus, the rubric, or the
   scoring math. Doing so is a material breach.

4. **No tampering with the license gate.** Do not patch, bypass, or
   network-isolate the binary's license-validation callback. Each
   invocation MUST reach the IFA endpoint and receive a valid
   attestation; an invocation that scores without a valid attestation
   is a material breach.

5. **Audit.** Every invocation is logged server-side (partner_id,
   binary build id, scan id, timestamp, source IP — no transcript
   content, no scored output). The log is retained for 90 days.

6. **Revocation.** IFA may revoke your license at any time. On
   revocation, the next invocation refuses to score (fail-closed).
   This is not a malfunction.

7. **Time-bounded.** This binary's license has an expiry date
   recorded in the build manifest. After expiry, the binary refuses to
   score. Renewal requires a fresh build delivered through the same
   channel.

The full text governs in case of any conflict with this summary. If you
do not agree, type anything other than "I ACCEPT" to abort.
